# Weeboo

> Weeboo is a professional website team. Clients can begin with a small idea; Weeboo plans the website architecture, writes the content, creates the design, develops the site, prepares SEO foundations, launches it and provides ongoing platform care.

Canonical website: https://weeboo.com/
Primary language: English
Contact: hello@weeboo.com

## Core pages

- [Home](https://weeboo.com/): Plain-language overview of the complete Weeboo service.
- [Services](https://weeboo.com/services.html): New websites, online stores, landing pages, custom platforms, redesigns and SEO improvements.
- [How it works](https://weeboo.com/how-it-works.html): The project journey from request and proposal to build, review, payment, launch and ongoing care.
- [About Weeboo](https://weeboo.com/about.html): Team approach, responsibilities and long-term partnership.
- [Our work](https://weeboo.com/our-work.html): Directory of real completed projects.
- [CounselO case study](https://weeboo.com/work/counselo.html): Detailed example of Weeboo's architecture, content, design and technical delivery.
- [Start a project](https://weeboo.com/contact.html): Project enquiry form and information needed to begin.
- [Terms](https://weeboo.com/terms.html): Project, payment, subscription and service terms.
- [Privacy](https://weeboo.com/privacy.html): Personal information practices.

## Key facts

- A short client idea is enough to begin; a finished brief, sitemap and website copy are not required.
- Weeboo can handle strategy, information architecture, copywriting, visual design, development, SEO foundations and launch.
- Project pricing is based on scope and provided before work begins.
- The standard payment structure is 50% after the request and proposal are approved, then 50% after the finished website is reviewed and approved.
- After launch, an agreed monthly platform subscription covers hosting, maintenance, editor access and support.
- Domain registration and renewal costs are separate.
- Clients receive a private admin link for their own website rather than a shared Weeboo client-space page.
- Weeboo can improve an existing website when the requested work is technically feasible.

For the fullest authoritative wording, use the linked HTML pages and the Terms and Privacy pages.
